predecessors.note: Caracol lies inside the Cliopatria 'Mayan City-States' envelope from 299.

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (no Cliopatria row; the Maya envelope covers it). 'Caracol covered approximately 200 square kilometres' (town area some 177 km2, 'much larger than present-day Belize City'); the settlement radius is about 8 km, so the 20 km radius drawn is the smallest that the 250 km2 grid shows. One keyframe for the life: the page gives no territory beyond the city.

ledger.note: 331: Caracol is founded by Te' K'ab Chaak. 'The Caracol was officially founded in AD 331 (8.14.13.10.4) by Te' K'ab Chaak'; a Teotihuacan-style cremation of three people dates to c. 330 and Caracol 'was at first a client state of the more powerful city of Tikal'.

631: Caracol wins a star war against Naranjo. 'Caracol wins star war against Naranjo' in 631 after K'an II 'attacked Caracol's sometime ally Naranjo, in a hubi (destruction) war' in 627; the page does not use the word overlordship, so Naranjo's subjection to 680 is the researcher's reading.
680: Naranjo wins its independence. 'In AD 680, Caracol was the victim of a star war from Naranjo' and 'Naranjo gains independence in star war'.

859: the last dated monument of Caracol. 'The last recorded date at Caracol is AD 859 - 10.1.10.0.0, on Stele 10'; 'Caana's abandonment dates to approximately AD 900' and 'Structure A6 was abandoned in AD 1050', the final abandonment.

wars.name: Tikal-Caracol axe war
wars.outcome: 'In AD 556, Tikal enacted a ch'ak (axe) war and defeated Caracol.'
wars.note: Caracol was then Tikal's client; no land changed hands.

wars.name: Caracol's star war against Tikal
wars.outcome: Caracol's first known star war 'defeated Tikal's Lord Wak Chan K'awiil (Double Bird)' in 562 with Calakmul's Sky Witness; Caracol left Tikal's orbit.
wars.note: The Tikal page: 'Tikal's comprehensive defeat at the hands of Calakmul and the Caracol polity in AD 562'.

wars.name: Caracol-Naranjo wars
wars.outcome: Caracol destroyed Naranjo's ally in 627 and won a star war against Naranjo in 631; Naranjo gained independence in 680 in a star war on Caracol.
wars.note: Calakmul page: Caracol 'defeated Naranjo c. 626' and Naranjo was 'independent of Calakmul by at least AD 626'.

certainty.note: No frontier is given anywhere; the radius is the grid's minimum, not a measured limit.

sources.title: Caracol
sources.note: Founded 331, client of Tikal, 556, 562, Naranjo 627-631 and 680, 800, 859, extent 200 km2.

notes:
NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no Caracol row. No native name is listed because the Caracol page opened does not give one.
SPHERE. The page gives only the 200 km2 town and 11 causeways; Caracol's reach over Naranjo (631-680) is a vassal event at confidence 2, and the 800 capture of the lord of Ucanal (K'inich Joy K'awiil, Stela 11) is not an event because Ucanal's land is not named. Calakmul's overlordship of Caracol (562 to about 618) is in the calakmul dossier.
END. Last Long Count date 859 (Stele 10); Cliopatria's Later shape drops Caracol in 850, so the two disagree by nine years.
